pages.title: Chibi Hatsune Miku and Kasane Teto Winter Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features chibi Hatsune Miku and Kasane Teto hugging in warm winter coats and scarves surrounded by falling snowflakes.

pages.title: Snow Miku 2011 Wearing Earmuffs and Mittens While Building a Snowman Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Snow Miku 2011 building a snowman while wearing earmuffs and mittens, with a small scarf-wearing rabbit sitting beside her. pages.title: Snow Miku and Rabbit Yukine Visiting Her Snow Sculpture at Sapporo Snow Festival Coloring Page
pages.description: Snow Miku and Rabbit Yukine visit her snow sculpture at Sapporo Snow Festival in this printable coloring page, with a tower rising behind them. pages.title: Snow Miku Riding the Snow Miku Streetcar Through Snowy Sapporo Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page follows Snow Miku riding her streetcar through snowy Sapporo, leaning at an open window with a rabbit companion beside her. Overhead wires and curving tracks lead toward a distant tower between buildings and snowy trees. The coloring sheet combines broad streetcar panels and flowing hair with finer window frames, snowflakes, and interior hand straps.

pages.title: Snow Miku Holding Rabbit Yukine Beside a Snow-covered Fir Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: Snow Miku holds Rabbit Yukine beside a snow-covered fir tree in this printable coloring page, wearing earmuffs, mittens, and a long scarf decorated with snowflakes.
